questions.question: How is each lesson in this course built?

answerOptions.text: Read a long chapter first, then take a timed test at the end
answerOptions.rationale: Lessons are short demos you follow along with, not reading and a timed test.

answerOptions.text: Only watch the videos; the practice files are optional extras
answerOptions.rationale: The practice workbook is central: you repeat each step on its sheet.

answerOptions.text: Watch the demo, do the same steps on the practice sheet, then check your work against the Done sheet
answerOptions.rationale: Every lesson follows watch, do, check, with answers on a Done sheet in the practice workbook.

answerOptions.text: Copy the finished workbook and change the numbers
answerOptions.rationale: You build the result yourself on the practice sheet and only use the Done sheet to check.

questions.question: Where do you check exactly which version of Excel is installed on your Mac?

answerOptions.rationale: About Excel shows the version number and whether it is a Microsoft 365 licence.
That is the Windows path; Excel for Mac has no File > Options.
This shows the macOS version and hardware, not the Excel version.
There is no version command on the Home tab.

questions.question: Which edition of Excel keeps receiving new functions, such as TEXTSPLIT and the REGEX functions, as they are released?

answerOptions.rationale: A one-time purchase version keeps the feature set it shipped with.
Older perpetual versions do not get new functions after release.

answerOptions.text: Any version, as long as macOS is up to date
answerOptions.rationale: Updating macOS does not add new Excel functions.
Microsoft 365 is updated regularly with new features and functions.

questions.question: On a Mac, how do you open the right-click menu on a cell?

answerOptions.rationale: Option-click does not open the context menu in Excel.

answerOptions.text: Control-click, or tap with two fingers on the trackpad
answerOptions.rationale: Control-click and a two-finger tap both act as a right-click on a Mac.
Command-click adds another cell or range to the selection.
Shift-click extends the selection up to the clicked cell.

questions.question: A Windows video tells you to go to File > Options. Where are the same settings in Excel for Mac?

answerOptions.rationale: Excel for Mac does not have File > Options.

answerOptions.text: Excel > Preferences (called Settings on newer macOS)
answerOptions.rationale: On a Mac, Excel's settings live under the Excel menu in the menu bar.
There is no Options command under Tools in Excel for Mac.
The ribbon has no Options button; settings are in the Excel menu.

questions.question: On most MacBooks, what must you hold to use F4 or F9 inside Excel?

answerOptions.rationale: Option does not turn the top row into function keys.
Command with the top row does not send F4 or F9 by default.

answerOptions.text: Nothing; Excel for Mac ignores function keys
answerOptions.rationale: Excel for Mac does use F-keys, such as F9 to calculate.
By default the top row controls brightness and volume, so fn turns them into F-keys.

questions.question: Excel on your Mac shows dates as MM/DD/YYYY and amounts with a $ sign. What should you change?

answerOptions.text: Set the Mac's region to India in System Settings > General > Language & Region
answerOptions.rationale: Excel for Mac takes its date order and currency from the macOS region setting.

answerOptions.text: Turn on AutoCorrect in Excel > Preferences
answerOptions.rationale: AutoCorrect fixes typing, not date order or currency.
The language of the app does not control the region formats.

answerOptions.text: Type every date with dots instead of slashes
answerOptions.rationale: The separator you type does not change how Excel reads the date order.

questions.question: The AutoSave switch at the top of the Excel window is greyed out. What turns it on?

answerOptions.rationale: A manual save to your Mac's disk does not enable AutoSave.

answerOptions.text: Moving the file to the Desktop folder
answerOptions.rationale: A local folder does not support AutoSave.

answerOptions.text: Saving the workbook to OneDrive (or SharePoint)
answerOptions.rationale: AutoSave works for files stored in OneDrive or SharePoint.
Calculation settings have nothing to do with AutoSave.
